high_level_description: The image is a slide from a presentation titled "PrivHAR: Recognizing Human Actions From Privacy-Preserving Lens." The slide compares different methods of recognizing human actions using privacy-preserving lenses. It includes five images labeled with the methods they represent: Low-resolution [1]: This image shows a person interacting with an object at a low resolution. The text below it states that this method loses information and significantly decreases action recognition. Defocus [2]: This image also shows a person interacting with an object but with a defocused effect.
